lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Pancakes. It is teatime, and Mummy Pig has a surprise for everyone.
lines.zh: 薄煎饼。下午茶时间到了，猪妈妈给大家准备了一个惊喜。

lines.en: Today is a day for pancakes! Pancakes! Delicious!
lines.zh: 今天是吃薄煎饼的日子！煎饼！真好吃！

lines.en: I love pancakes. Everyone loves pancakes. I'm the expert at flipping the pancakes over. Leave that to me.
lines.zh: 我喜欢煎饼。大家都喜欢煎饼。我最擅长给煎饼翻面了。交给我吧。

lines.en: Are you sure, Daddy Pig? Last time you got a bit grumpy when you dropped the pancake on the floor. I did not get grumpy. There was a problem with the frying pan.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸，你确定吗？上次你把煎饼掉在地上，就有点发脾气了。我才没有发脾气。是那个平底锅有问题。

lines.en: Mummy, can we help make the pancakes, please? Yes, you can help me make the batter.
lines.zh: 妈妈，我们能帮忙做煎饼吗？可以，你们可以帮我调面糊。

lines.en: First, I put some flour in the bowl. Ooh! Now I add an egg. Now the milk, and I give it all a stir.
lines.zh: 首先，我在碗里放些面粉。哦！现在加一个鸡蛋。现在加牛奶，然后全部搅一搅。

lines.en: Mummy, can I stir? Yes, of course, Peppa. Peppa loves stirring. George wants to stir as well.
lines.zh: 妈妈，我能搅吗？当然可以，佩奇。佩奇喜欢搅拌。乔治也想搅。

lines.en: No, George, like this. Okay, that's enough stirring, you two. Sit at the table while I cook the pancakes.
lines.zh: 不对，乔治，要像这样。好了，你们俩搅够了。坐到桌边去，我来烙煎饼。

lines.en: Mummy Pig is going to flip the pancake over.
lines.zh: 猪妈妈要把煎饼翻个面。

lines.en: Hooray! You could flip it higher, Mummy Pig. You can show us how when you flip your own pancake, Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 太好啦！猪妈妈，你可以翻得更高一点。猪爸爸，等你烙自己那张的时候，可以给我们露一手。

lines.en: This first pancake is for George. Mummy Pig pours a little syrup on George's pancake.
lines.zh: 第一张煎饼给乔治。猪妈妈在乔治的煎饼上浇了一点糖浆。

lines.en: Delicious! This pancake is for Peppa.
lines.zh: 真好吃！这张煎饼给佩奇。

lines.en: Hooray! You could flip it higher, Mummy Pig. You will get a chance to show me when you flip your own pancake, Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 太好啦！猪妈妈，你可以翻得更高。猪爸爸，等你翻自己那张的时候，你就有机会给我们示范了。

lines.en: Hmm, please. Mmm.
lines.zh: 嗯，请给我。嗯。

lines.en: Delicious! This pancake is for Mummy Pig.
lines.zh: 真好吃！这张煎饼给猪妈妈。

lines.en: Hooray! You still aren't flipping them high enough, Mummy Pig. The next pancake is yours, Daddy Pig, so now you can show us how it should be done.
lines.zh: 太好啦！猪妈妈，你还是翻得不够高。下一张是你的了，猪爸爸，现在你可以给我们示范该怎么做了。

lines.en: Delicious! Hmm. Is everyone watching? The secret of making a good pancake is to flip it high into the air.
lines.zh: 真好吃！嗯。大家都看着吗？做出好煎饼的秘诀，就是把它在空中翻得高高的。

lines.en: Ah! One, two, three... hoopla!
lines.zh: 啊！一、二、三……飞喽！

lines.en: Silly Daddy! Oh, maybe that was just a bit too high. What a shame, that was the last pancake. It should be a simple matter to get it down.
lines.zh: 傻爸爸！哦，也许翻得有点太高了。真可惜，那是最后一张煎饼了。把它弄下来应该是件很简单的事。

lines.en: Oh, dear. Daddy Pig cannot reach his pancake. Don't worry, Daddy Pig, I think I know a way to get it down. Let's go upstairs, children. This way.
lines.zh: 哦，天哪。猪爸爸够不着他的煎饼。别担心，猪爸爸，我想我知道怎么把它弄下来。孩子们，我们上楼去。这边走。

lines.en: What is Mummy Pig planning to do?
lines.zh: 猪妈妈打算做什么呢？

lines.en: On the count of three, we all have to start jumping up and down. One, two, three, jump!
lines.zh: 数到三的时候，我们大家一起用力往上跳。一、二、三，跳！

lines.en: It worked! Now Daddy Pig has his pancake. Daddy has a pancake on his head!
lines.zh: 成功了！现在猪爸爸拿到他的煎饼了。爸爸头上顶着一张煎饼！

lines.en: Syrup on your pancake, Daddy Pig? Yes, please.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸，你的煎饼要浇糖浆吗？好的，来一点。

lines.en: One, two, three.
lines.zh: 一、二、三。

lines.en: Delicious!
lines.zh: 真好吃！
